Ad blocks sit in #tads (under #tvcap), [data-dsktp-pla] (under #cnt, or as a data-dsktp-pla=false wrapper inside #rso with its own "Sponsored results" header), and #bottomads > #tadsb. On the Shopping tab the "Sponsored products" carousel is #tads holding [data-pla] items and no [data-text-ad], so #tads itself is the marker. These containers hold only ads, so adContainerSelector hides the outermost one and its header goes with it. Per-ad text carries no Sponsored label, so detection is structural. #rso .MjjYud nests (one wrapper held 11 results): the scanner keeps innermost units only. [data-pla] is deliberately not a marker on its own: only seen inside #tads, and an organic product module using it would be hidden whole. Selector avoids complex :not() (happy-dom ignores it).
